review_notes: Publication rule (docs/TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md D24): a project is published once publish_status is "published" and its repository has been checked by hand (repository_status "verified"). The build fails otherwise.
A contribution statement is shown only when its wording is confirmed: role_status "approved" with role_statement set. While pending, role_statement must stay null.

projects.category: AI-Powered Study Platform for CS Students
projects.problem_statement: CS students studying from their own PDFs need answers grounded in that source material, along with practice material and tools to plan and track revision.
projects.description: A full-stack study platform where students upload PDFs and get source-grounded answers through RAG, with Gemini-generated flashcards and quizzes and a local RAG fallback that shows retrieved source text when no API key is set. It offers study modes (explain simply, hint, debug code, viva practice), a subject library, a revision tracker, a planner and saved conversations, with student accounts using signed tokens and hashed passwords. The system has a FastAPI backend, a Next.js frontend and an automated test suite for the API, chat, study and planner features.
projects.role_statement: RAG, study planning, quizzes, NLP, FastAPI, and SQLite.
projects.review_note: Repository verified 2026-10-31: public, under the teammate account akshita-sharda; README is StudyForge AI.

projects.problem_statement: Managing personal money means recording income and expenses, watching monthly budgets and remembering recurring payments, with records that stay safe and easy to understand.
projects.description: A personal finance tracker with one Python core and two interfaces: a menu-driven command-line app and a React and TypeScript web app served through a thin FastAPI layer. It records income and expenses with search and filtering, tracks monthly budgets with a warning at 80% and an alert when exceeded, and generates weekly or monthly recurring transactions without duplicates. Reports cover monthly summaries, category breakdowns, month comparisons and spending trends, with savings calculated as income minus expenses and a next-month estimate from a simple three-month average. Data stays in local JSON files with atomic saves, validated CSV import and export, checksummed backups and recovery from corrupted files.
projects.review_note: Repository verified 2026-11-06: public, owned by singhaasveer-lab, and its HEAD (01eeccc) matches the local source. Text and technologies come from the source code and are not on the resume. There is no authentication, database or AI: storage is JSON files, and the next-month figure is a three-month average. No deployment exists, so demo_url stays null. No contribution statement is shown.

projects.problem_statement: Students preparing for technical, behavioral (STAR) and system-design interviews need realistic practice questions and structured feedback on each answer.
projects.description: A full-stack mock interview platform with adaptive difficulty and both MCQ and open-ended questions generated on demand by Gemini. An AI evaluation step scores each answer on technical depth, communication clarity, problem solving and executive confidence, with model answers, strengths, weak spots and a prep roadmap. The platform also includes a Resume ATS Scanner, a Job Description Analyzer with match scoring, a RAG knowledge base that ranks notes by keyword matches, a voice interview room (speech-to-text) and a live coding sandbox that evaluates time/space complexity.
projects.review_note: Repository verified 2026-10-31: public, owned by singhaasveer-lab, description matches. No contribution statement is shown. Knowledge-base wording corrected 2026-11-06 to match backend/app/routes/rag.py, which ranks chunks by keyword matches.

projects.problem_statement: Chat screenshots hold interaction signals such as warmth, reciprocity and engagement that are hard to turn into clear next-step recommendations, reply strategies and date plans.
projects.description: An AI platform that reads chat screenshots with OCR and analyzes interaction signals. A multi-stage pipeline runs Screenshot OCR, NLP Signal Analysis, Conversation DNA profiling, RAG Retrieval, Decision Brief and Reply Strategies. A local RAG knowledge base uses TF-IDF vectorization and cosine-similarity retrieval, with SQLite persistence, a FastAPI REST backend and a Streamlit interface.

projects.category: Hybrid ML + Generative AI Gift Recommendation System
projects.problem_statement: Gift suggestions need to fit the recipient's relationship, occasion, interests, personality, budget and things to avoid, and an AI model should never invent products that do not exist.
projects.description: A hybrid recommender that ranks real catalogue items before any generation happens: candidates are filtered and scored with TF-IDF, cosine similarity and weighted scoring against the recipient's relationship, occasion, interests, personality, budget and things to avoid. The Gemini LLM acts as a personalization layer that explains why each gift fits, how to personalize and present it, and drafts a message to include. The pipeline is exposed through a FastAPI backend with SQLite-based history and a Streamlit frontend.
projects.role_statement: TF-IDF, cosine similarity, weighted recommendation scoring and Gemini personalization.
projects.review_note: Repository verified 2026-10-31: public, owned by singhaasveer-lab, description matches. Contribution wording is the owner's; each item is in recommender.py or gemini_service.py.

projects.problem_statement: Physical waiting lines give visitors no view of their position or likely wait, and give staff no single place to dispatch people across several service counters or to see where the queue is backing up.
projects.description: A digital queue management system that replaces physical lines with real-time tokens. Visitors choose a service category, join a standard or priority queue, and follow their live position and estimated wait. Staff open and close counters, call the next token to a specific desk, and complete, skip or recall tokens, while a public display with a fullscreen kiosk mode shows who is being served, with chimes and spoken token announcements. A rule-based queue intelligence engine derives congestion from the ratio of waiting visitors to open counters, estimates clearance time from the service backlog, flags bottlenecks and priority load, answers staff questions by keyword and simulates traffic surges. An analytics view reports waiting and service times, throughput, priority share and no-shows, with CSV and JSON export. Queue state persists in the browser and stays in sync across open tabs.
projects.role_statement: Queue management, token generation, queue-position information, wait-time estimation and staff dispatch.
